content.comment_body: Hello, I need assistance with automatically logging data from [product_name] [version_no] to an Excel file. For example, I want data from the analog input to be sent to Excel every 10 seconds. Thank you.

Hello, data logging can function without a PC or Excel. If you need direct recording to Excel, you have two options: 1) Use the I/O Status feature (under Tools/Transfer, I/O-Status) to enable recording to a CSV file. 2) Use [product_name] Access Tool, available on the [product_name] [document] in the Tools folder. This tool acts as an MS Excel Add-In, which should suit your needs. Hope this helps.
